path_base: All asset paths are relative to the extracted package root.
inventory_policy: Canonical source assets only; dist contains runtime copies. Only the selected outputs are included, not discarded alternatives or superseded draft images.

ai_use.art_direction: Hero alternatives were evaluated before implementation; this package retains only the selected hero and selected scene, material, transition and mobile references.
ai_use.production: AI generation directly supplies a transparent sculpture cutout, two empty architectural plates and one black-stone texture.
ai_use.live_authored_work: The persistent fragmented sculpture, camera-ray alignment, camera paths, planar mirror reflection, rift depth, membrane refraction, material/light changes and reassembly are authored geometry, shaders and runtime code. They are not pre-rendered AI animation.
ai_use.copy: Reference-image lettering is art direction; navigation, headings and chapter copy in the running site are live DOM text.
ai_use.reproducibility: Prompts and output IDs document the generation history. Re-generating an AI image is not guaranteed to reproduce identical pixels.
